# Synthetic XLS fixture

`structure-synthetic.xls` was generated for this repository with xlwt 1.3.0.
It contains one worksheet: a merged `Header`, `Pump`, zero, a literal string
`=literal` and a formula `B2+1` without an evaluated result. No project data,
macros, links or external files. The writer is a fixture generation tool only;
the application reads XLS with xlrd and cannot recover formula expressions.
